scope: Sensitivity to visible-answer phrasing, independent of the primary scorer. Review every completed turn with a nonempty answer other than a literal yes, no or maybe (case and final punctuation ignored). Include scored and unscored answers. Deduplicate only the same article, excerpt, claim and reply.
blind: Reviewer receives only excerpt, claim and complete visible reply, in hash order, with no model identity, publisher label, primary score or timing. Assign yes, no, unclear or internally conflicting according to the model's asserted conclusion. Ambiguous, inconsistent, unfinished and empty replies receive zero credit. Preserve the immutable registered decision.
